general.data_management_description: Export, clear, or reset your application data.
general.clear_data_description: This will delete all your data including saved jobs, resumes, and settings. This action cannot be undone.
general.reset_settings_description: This will reset all settings to their default values. Your data will not be affected.
general.app_description: Job search assistant for tech professionals — pick the countries you're job hunting in

llm.title: AI Model Configuration
llm.description: Configure your AI providers. You need at least one provider set up for AI features.
llm.byot_notice: Bring Your Own Token (BYOT) - Use your own API keys, or run models yourself with Ollama. Joseador Remoto never stores keys in plain text.

ollama.description: Run open models on this machine, a server on your local network, or Ollama Cloud.
ollama.hint_local: Install Ollama from ollama.com and keep it running (ollama serve). Pull a model first, e.g. ollama pull qwen3:8b.
ollama.hint_lan: IP or hostname of the machine running Ollama (default port 11434). That server must listen on the network: set OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0 before starting it.
ollama.hint_remote: https://ollama.com for Ollama Cloud (API key required), or the URL of your own server, e.g. behind a reverse proxy.
ollama.api_key: API key (Ollama Cloud or token-protected server)
ollama.custom_model_placeholder: Or type a model name, e.g. llama3.1:70b
ollama.model_not_installed: "{{model}}" is not installed on this server. Run: ollama pull {{model}}
ollama.num_ctx_hint: Maximum text the model can read at once. Each request uses only what it needs, up to this limit. CVs + job posts need 16k or more; larger values use more RAM/VRAM.
ollama.unreachable_local: Is Ollama running? Start it with ollama serve (or open the Ollama app).
ollama.unreachable_lan: Check the address, that both machines are on the same network, and that the server was started with OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0 (and its firewall allows port 11434).
ollama.unreachable_remote: Check the URL and API key. For Ollama Cloud, create a key at ollama.com/settings/keys.
ollama.auto_load: Load the model into memory when selected
ollama.auto_start: Start Ollama when the app opens
ollama.unload_on_exit: Unload models when closing the app
ollama.unload_on_exit_lan_hint: On a shared server this also frees the model for anyone else using it.

scraping.title: Job Search (Scraping)
scraping.description: "Search jobs" pulls postings from the sources below — free, legitimate feeds work out of the box. Everything runs on this computer; keys stay in your system's credential store. Every job is kept (eligibility for your markets is a badge and filter, never a reason to drop one).
scraping.serpapi_hint: Free plan: 250 searches/month (1 page = 1 search = up to 10 jobs).
scraping.queries_hint: One search phrase per term, English and Spanish. Don't add words like "remote" — remoteness is enforced by an API filter.
scraping.titles_hint: Job-title filters for the LinkedIn search. End a term with :* to match any title starting with it (e.g. iOS:*). All titles run in a single search.
scraping.caps_hint: Hard caps checked before every paid request, so a run can never exceed your plan. One SerpApi page = 1 search; one Apify run covers all titles and costs per result.

blacklist.title: Blocked companies
blacklist.description: Jobs from these companies are hidden everywhere — the job list, recommendations and the report. Add scam or unwanted companies by name; remove one and its jobs come back. Matching is case-insensitive.

markets.title: Where are you job hunting?
markets.description: Job eligibility, sources, CV conventions and salary formatting follow these markets. Changes apply immediately.
markets.residence_help: Used to judge remote roles ("remote from where I live"). It never leaves this device.
markets.targets_help: Countries you'd work in (on-site or remote), regions like Latin America, or remote worldwide.
markets.work_auth: Countries you can legally work in
markets.work_auth_help: Citizenship, residency or visas. Jobs that require these authorizations won't be marked as restricted.
markets.relocate_help: Shown to the CV assistant; on-site roles abroad still need work authorization.
markets.contractor_help: Many international remote roles hire LATAM talent as contractors.

sources.title: Job sources
sources.description: Free, official job feeds. Each one's terms ask us to credit it and link back to the original posting, which we do on every job.
sources.not_for_markets: Has little or nothing for your current markets.

coverage.remote: Remote jobs worldwide, filtered for where you live
coverage.latam: Tech jobs in Latin America and Spain (remote and on-site)
coverage.countries: Local job sites of your target countries — needs your own free key
coverage.companies: Every opening on the career boards of companies you follow
coverage.google: Google for Jobs results through SerpApi (paid key)
coverage.linkedin: LinkedIn job search through an Apify scraper (paid token)

sources.companies_description: Add a company's Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby job board and every new opening there is imported, straight from the employer.
sources.boards_hint: Paste a board link, e.g. job-boards.greenhouse.io/acme, jobs.lever.co/acme or jobs.ashbyhq.com/acme.
sources.board_invalid: {{board}} isn't a Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby job board link
sources.scrapers_title: Scraping services (use at your own risk)
sources.scrapers_description: These resell data scraped from Google and LinkedIn. They keep working if you already use them, but consider the free sources above instead.

legal_note.serpapi: Google sued SerpApi in December 2025 for circumventing its anti-scraping protections.
legal_note.apify-linkedin: LinkedIn's terms forbid scraping; LinkedIn has sued scrapers and restricts accounts linked to them.

privacy.data_description: What the app keeps and where it goes.
privacy.fact_local: Your CVs, jobs and applications are stored only on this computer.
privacy.fact_keys: API keys live in your operating system's credential store, not in the app's database.
privacy.fact_llm: Text is sent to an AI provider only when you use an AI feature, and only to the provider you chose (with Ollama it never leaves your network).
privacy.fact_rights: You can delete your CVs and applications at any time, and clear stored page text below (your rights under the DR's Ley 172-13, the GDPR and the LGPD).
privacy.retention_label: Keep the original text of pasted and captured pages
privacy.retention_hint: Job fields and descriptions are always kept; this only limits how long the raw copied page text is stored.
privacy.cleared_one: Cleared the page text of {{count}} job
privacy.cleared_other: Cleared the page text of {{count}} jobs
